result_values.interpretation: observational result-conditional mean delta RE, not intervention value

calibration.limitations: Chronological observational samples may shift; empirical coverage is not an exchangeability guarantee.

model_info.selection_rule: validation pitch log loss; within 0.005 nats prefer context LGB then history LGB then GRU; GRU zone/result may degrade at most 0.03 nats vs history LGB
model_info.selection_reason: lightgbm_history is the simplest eligible model within 0.005 nats of best validation pitch log loss (1.158778).
